sections_target.text: Spare parts that may be changed as required:
Work steps to be carried out

rows: Rig the chain block or Tirfor in preparation for lifting the pump.
Isolate the pump electrically and mechanically, take the switch out and place a warning card on it.
Undo the pump suction and discharge bolts.
Place the pump on wooden blocks on a tazga.
Dismantle the front and rear bearings, check them and check the packing.
Undo 8 studs for assembling the pump.
Measure the clearance of the impeller with the stationary part and record it.
Internal inspection of the condition of the impellers and stationary parts, and replace as necessary.
Replace the suction and discharge gaskets.
Reseat the discharge valve and restore the circuit.
After inspection and verifying the condition, replace as required and reassemble in reverse order.
After the repair and reinstallation are complete, run the pump and check the condition in terms of:

- Vibration - discharge pressure and quantity - motor operating current
Bearing temperature rise
in accordance with the performance curves

Introduction
This document covers the periodic maintenance of the (Clean Drain Tank) C.D.T pump. The document was prepared by Eng. Mohamed Salim Salman and Eng. Ahmed Mostafa El-Sabbagh on 14 June 2003, and the electronic correspondence was carried out over the Internet with the assistance of Eng. Mohamed Salim Salman.
It was implemented based on previous experience by Eng. Ahmed Mostafa El-Sabbagh. The document was reviewed by Eng. Abouda El-Banna, Technical Inspection and Quality Control Engineer, and Eng. Mohamed El-Sayed Abdel Ghaffar, General Manager of the station, and approved by Eng. Awad Mohamed Fathy, Head of the Power Stations Sector.
